"Lower your costs, not your wages"

✅ Lower the cost of Rx Drugs
✅ Let Medicare negotiate price of Rx drugs
✅ Lower energy costs
✅ Cut the costs of child care
✅ Corporations to pay a fair share

I strongly support universal health coverage and will continue to take steps to strengthen the #ACA by ⬇️

✅ Lowering health coverage costs
✅ Negotiating lower drug prices
✅ Combating inequity in health 

#ThxACA

Last night, I supported @RepAnnaEshoo’s bipartisan #EnsuringLastingSmiles Act, to ensure health coverage for treatment and procedures for children born with anomalies or defects. https://t.co/MpyvA2bBS8

On the anniversary of his passing, I honor Ryan and his legacy.

Because of Ryan’s advocacy, Americans living with AIDS today receive lifesaving treatment and live long and happy lives.

I welcomed @SecBecerra to #Everett to talk with stakeholders & leaders about the critical need to invest in affordable behavioral health care, addiction prevention & treatment, workforce training & other services to regain momentum in the fight against the opioid crisis. #HHSTour https://t.co/G2gNGuyEzQ

Privatizing Medicare will not make Washington seniors healthier.

I am hearing from concerned constituents that Medicare’s DCE model may impact their quality of choice in medical coverage and undermine traditional fee-for-service Medicare, and I agree.

https://t.co/H0I1E1Tn7r

100,000+ uninsured Washingtonians are unable to purchase coverage through @WAplanfinder due to federal restrictions. 

Washington state’s Section 1332 State Innovation Waiver would eliminate these restrictions and promote health equity. https://t.co/Np6ivIWOUA

The #InflationReductionAct will lower health care costs for people in Washington state and across the country, saving 13 million people an average of $800 each year.

Today, I met with @CompassHealthWA in Everett to discuss how the law will benefit patients in NW Washington. https://t.co/ft4Gvj5wiw
The #InflationReductionAct will lower costs for low-income and uninsured families, including those who receive treatment at the Community Health Center of Snohomish County. https://t.co/AJXqWU2Ucq

This week, I toured the newly remodeled #Everett-Central Clinic & met with CEO Joe Vessey & his team to discuss how the #InflationReductionAct will help more patients access affordable health care & prescription drugs. https://t.co/SH7bgFKrDL

The #InflationReductionAct takes bold action to enable Washingtonians to save on ⬇️

💊 Prescription drugs
🩺 Health premiums
🌎 Energy prices, and much more

The #InflationReductionAct will ⬇️

✅ Expand Medicare benefits to lower out-of-pocket costs
✅ Lower health care costs by locking in lower premiums
✅ Reduce carbon emissions by roughly 40% by 2030
✅ Take historic action to fight inflation, and much more https://t.co/80FkIh3Vbt

Tens of thousands of #WA02 seniors depend on Medicare to stay healthy & get healthier. Thank you to @BMAlliance for inviting me to discuss ways to strengthen & improve Medicare & how the #InflationReductionAct makes health care more affordable for seniors & working families. https://t.co/2aHhRxpP2I

Diagnostic testing plays a critical role in detecting and preventing the spread of disease in Washington state and across the country.

On Wednesday, I visited @adxhealth, a diagnostic testing lab in Bellingham that provides services to clinicians and hospitals nationwide. https://t.co/XmkQozrwyo

The number of Washingtonians experiencing hunger doubled to 30 percent during the COVID-19 pandemic. 
 
On Friday, I toured the Stanwood Camano Food Bank and the new Thrift Store and met with staff to discuss how to reduce hunger and improve nutrition in local communities. https://t.co/NNeBs1e3Pe

A reminder 🩺🏥➡️ The @WAplanfinder open enrollment period deadline is tomorrow, Thursday, December 15, for coverage that begins January 1, 2023. 

Head over to https://t.co/symoGciyHL for more info. #GetCoveredWA

Democrats are ready to govern, protecting and building on one of the most successful two years ever. Instead, my GOP colleagues were unable to exercise their prerogative to organize their majority. They failed.

On 1/6/21, I was in my office as domestic terrorists stormed the Capitol, attacked law enforcement & threatened the exercise of democracy. 

Democracy bent but did not break on January 6. I never doubted the outcome of that day: Congress would affirm the election of @POTUS & @VP.
Thanks to the #InflationReductionAct, 28,063 Washingtonians enrolled in Medicare Part D & B coverage will save an average of $600+ per year on insulin copays. @HHSGov

.@HouseDemocrats are focused on protecting Social Security & Medicare from extreme R attacks & implementing the infrastructure law & the #InflationReductionAct to create more jobs, drive economic growth, lower costs for working families & ensure 🇺🇸 remains globally competitive.

Happy 1⃣3⃣th anniversary, Affordable Care Act!

Since the #ACA became law in 2010, hundreds of thousands of Washingtonians have signed up for quality health coverage through @WAplanfinder or WA Apple Health, the state’s Medicaid provider. https://t.co/ia8T3WP0CJ

The #InflationReductionAct extended for three years the ACA tax credits included in the #AmericanRescuePlan, lowering health costs & helping 21,000 more #WA02 residents access affordable health coverage last year.

Today, I sat down with Mt. Baker @PPFA staff to hear about the clinic’s experience with mifepristone & their important work to deliver reporoductive health care to patients in Northwest Washington. https://t.co/FYQsszTsrV

The GOP's #DefaultOnAmerica Act would ⬇️

❌ Cut ~$67 million in Title I funding for WA schools serving low-income children
❌ Eliminate preschool and child care for ~4,800 children in WA
❌ Put ~371,000 people at risk of losing Medicaid coverage in Washington

❌ Make college more expensive for ~89,400 students in WA
❌ Threaten access to nutrition assistance for ~187,000 people in WA
